title: An email to the professor
scene: Anna writes her first email in English to a professor. She logs in to her account with her username, uses a template, puts her name in the header and the date with a slash, and attaches her homework in PDF format; then she checks her inbox all evening and finds his reply in spam, with a link to a reading list.

words.ex: I'll send you an email tonight.
I forgot the password to my account.
Enter your username and password, please.
Use this template for your resume.
Add your name to the header of the page.
Type a slash between the two dates.
Send the file in PDF format.
I have fifty new emails in my inbox.
Thanks for your quick reply to my email.
My inbox is full of spam again today.
Can you send me the link, please?
The app has many users.

old_story: Anna had to write her first [[email]] in English to a professor. She logged in to her [[account]] with her [[username]]. Then she chose a simple [[template]]. She put her name in the [[header]]. She put a [[slash]] between the day and the month. Then she attached her homework in PDF [[format]]. All evening she checked her [[inbox]], but nothing came. Max said, "Maybe his [[reply]] is in [[spam]]." He was right! The professor thanked her and sent a [[link]] to a reading list.

title: Train tickets online
scene: Anna buys train tickets with an online service. The website opens slowly in her browser and the layout is confusing; while browsing she closes pop-ups, clicks 'buy', enters the code from an SMS and takes a screenshot of the QR code, which the conductor scans on the train.

words.ex: Do you use this online service?
Please visit our website for more information.
Open this link in your web browser, please.
I like the layout of the new website.
Private browsing does not save your history.
A pop-up asked me to accept the cookies.
With one click, you can order food to your door.
Enter the code to open the door.
Take a screenshot of the error.
Scan the QR code to see the menu.
Send me a scan of your passport, please.
I buy shoes on this site.
I found this recipe on the web.
Open the link in your web browser, please.

old_story: Anna wanted train tickets to Lviv, so she tried an [[online service]]. The [[website]] opened very slowly in her [[browser]]. The [[layout]] was confusing, and she could not find the tickets. While [[browsing]], she closed three [[pop-ups|pop-up]]. Finally, with one [[click]], she bought tickets for her and Max. Then she entered the [[code]] from an [[SMS]]. She took a [[screenshot]] of the [[QR code]] for the trip. On the train, the conductor checked her phone. Anna showed him a [[scan]] of her student card too. Everything was fine, and the trip began.

title: Max's new flat goes online
scene: Max needs internet in his new flat: a technician from the provider brings a router and a modem, fixes a connector and the antenna and does the setup. Then Max builds a home office with a big monitor, a headset and a microphone for calls, a printer that needs a new cartridge, a scanner, a tripod for video calls, and an adapter and a converter for his old plugs.

words.ex: We changed our internet provider last month.
Try restarting the router if the internet is slow.
Restart the modem if the internet stops working.
The cable has a USB connector at one end.
We need to put the antenna on the roof.
My gaming setup cost a lot of money.
I work from my home office three days a week.
I use two monitors at work.
Put on your headset for the video call.
Speak into the microphone, please.
The printer in our office is out of paper.
The printer needs a new ink cartridge.
I used the scanner to copy my passport.
The phone has a bright, clear display.

old_story: Max's new flat had no internet. On Monday, a technician from his [[provider]] came. He brought a [[router]] and a [[modem]]. He fixed a bad [[connector]] and moved the [[antenna]] on the roof. Then Max made a small [[home office]] in his bedroom. His new [[setup]] had a big [[monitor]] and a [[headset]]. It also had a good [[microphone]] for video calls. He bought an old [[printer]], but it needed a new [[cartridge]]. Anna brought him her old [[scanner]] as a housewarming gift. "Now I can work from home!" Max said happily.

title: Anna's family tree
scene: Anna draws her family tree for Max: her mama, her siblings, a new baby cousin and the whole clan. Grandpa was an admiral and is now a pensioner who still uses an old telephone; Mama, a millennial, says Grandpa is a boomer and a true optimist - and Anna has his genes.

words.ex: Mama, can I have some milk?
How many siblings do you have?
The baby is hungry.
My cousin lives in Kyiv.
Our whole clan meets at my grandmother's every summer.
The pensioner lives alone in a small apartment.
My dad is a true optimist about everything.
The placenta gives the baby food and oxygen.
She is a realist and plans for problems.
She is in her second trimester of pregnancy.
Thanks a lot, bro!
Hey sis, can you help me with my homework?

old_story: Anna draws her family tree for Max. Her parents and two [[siblings|sibling]] are on it. Aunt Olha is in her last [[trimester]]. The [[placenta]] and the [[baby]] are healthy. Soon Anna has a new [[cousin]]! "Your [[clan]] is very big!" Max says. Grandpa is an old [[admiral]], now a [[pensioner]]. He still has an old [[telephone]] at home. [[Mama|mama]] is a [[millennial]], and Grandpa is a [[boomer]]. Grandpa is an [[optimist]], but Grandma is a [[realist]]. "You have his [[genes|gene]]," Max laughs.

title: A surprise party for Mama
scene: Anna and Taras plan a surprise party for Mama's birthday. They send an invite to the family, order a bouquet from a florist, throw confetti, sing karaoke and give Mama a scrapbook of old photos; Mama's friend brings coffee liqueur and pays everyone a compliment.

words.ex: We are planning a surprise party for Mom.
Thanks for the invite to your party!
He gave her a bouquet of roses.
I ordered flowers from the florist for her birthday.
They threw confetti at the wedding.
We sang karaoke with friends until midnight.
She keeps a scrapbook of family photos.
She added a little coffee liqueur to the cake.
She paid me a nice compliment today.
We looked at old photos in the photo album.

old_story: Anna and her brother Taras planned a [[surprise]] party for Mama's birthday. They sent an [[invite]] to the whole family. Taras ordered a big [[bouquet]] from a [[florist]] near their home. When Mama came home, everyone shouted and threw [[confetti]]. Anna gave her a [[scrapbook]] of old family photos. Mama cried happy tears. Her friend Lida brought a cake with coffee [[liqueur]]. Then they all sang [[karaoke]] until late. Then Mama paid her kids a sweet [[compliment]]: "You are the best!"
